description: Activate when: brand perception lags product quality; a values campaign generated backlash ('they say X but do Y'); NPS and brand sentiment diverge; marketing underperforms despite a good product; someone asks 'how do we build brand trust?' or 'why isn't our marketing working?'. Do NOT activate when: a single catastrophic event requires immediate legal or crisis-communication response first; the product genuinely does not work and needs engineering fixes before trust is addressed. More: deciqai.com/c/trust-brand-architecture
